boundary_link.hint.loop: Click a wall: the closed run of walls becomes linked edges
boundary_link.hint.repick: Click a wall parallel to the edge: the edge will follow it
boundary_link.need_edge: Point at an edge of the sketch
boundary_link.need_straight: Only a straight edge can follow a wall
boundary_link.not_parallel: The wall is not parallel to the edge
boundary_link.not_linked: This edge is not linked to a wall
boundary_link.unlinked: Edge unlinked: it stays in place and no longer follows the wall
boundary_link.accepted: Edges accepted: they stay in place as ordinary edges
